name: Is laminate flooring a good choice for kitchens and bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: Is laminate flooring a good choice for kitchens and bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional laminate flooring is generally not recommended for high-moisture areas like kitchens and bathrooms because its wood-based core can swell and warp if exposed to standing water or excessive humidity. However, manufacturers now offer water-resistant or even waterproof laminate options designed with enhanced core materials and tighter locking systems. If considering laminate for these areas, it is crucial to select a product specifically rated for moisture resistance and ensure proper installation to seal out water. Otherwise, luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or tile might be more suitable alternatives.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional laminate is not ideal for high-moisture areas like kitchens and bathrooms. However, specialized water-resistant laminate or LVP can be used.
